release.deploymentObservation: A missing-snapshot guard appeared during each deployment. Later reloads rendered the actual final build; no runtime patch or admin reboot was needed. Hosted checkout/rerun delay is an inference, not an inspected server log.

backup.transport: Base archives via mounted Drive followed by web verification; final supplement and companions uploaded through Drive web after G: mount disappeared.

reviewExport.toolLimitation: Blob downloads are not supported in embedded frames.
reviewExport.meaning: The selected in-app browser cannot complete this Blob download. This is not proof of a failure in ordinary browsers; regular-browser delivery still requires a returned JSON test. No review decisions were entered or imported during live verification.

remainingBoundaries: Browser-only unexported reviews, including Chris’s remote browser, are not automatically backed up.
Google Drive Desktop showed four errors and later lost its G: mount. Those desktop-sync issues are unresolved; the dated backup was completed and verified separately through the web.
Eight preexisting JS test failures remain documented in validation_summary.json; all18 targeted native cases passed after corrections and isolated retries. No full282-test all-green claim.
CFA project recovery only: credentials, installed runtimes, Windows and sibling repositories are outside this source snapshot.
Every casting/location/intake choice remains with its human reviewer. No new creative acceptance was recorded.
finalCompanionPolicy: This closeout receipt and audit companions are committed separately and copied to the dated backup folder; they are not recursively included inside the archive whose checksum they report.

repositoryFootprint.interpretation: Historical generated snapshots make the checkout much larger than unique content. No disk-full cause was established for the temporary deployment error. Retention cleanup is future maintenance; no historical snapshots were deleted in this audit.
